dimensions.name: Recognition
dimensions.question: Does the customer recognize their own answers, goals and tensions?

dimensions.name: Traceability
dimensions.question: Can every important inference be traced to explicit evidence/reason codes?

dimensions.name: Differentiation
dimensions.question: Are Strong, Adjacent and Overlooked meaningfully different?

dimensions.name: WorkStyle
dimensions.question: Does the analysis explain fit, friction and possible redesign without fixed labels?

dimensions.name: Depth
dimensions.question: Can the customer understand and begin investigating each top opportunity?

dimensions.name: IncomeEvidence
dimensions.question: Are income claims sourced/scenario-based and clearly bounded?

dimensions.name: MarketAccess
dimensions.question: Does the customer know who to contact and what first action to take?

dimensions.name: Actionability
dimensions.question: Are 30-day actions and 90-day experiments concrete and bounded?

dimensions.name: Agency
dimensions.question: Does language preserve customer choice rather than prescribe an identity?

dimensions.name: ResearchFreshness
dimensions.question: Are time-sensitive claims dated and sourced?

releaseRule: No blockers; human reviewer approval required before PDF render.
